name: evaluate-external-tool
description: Give a verdict on someone else's tool, repo or product: ADOPT, CANARY, PARK or STEAL-IDEA, backed by a live sandbox trial and a comparison with what you already have. Use when you get a link and the question "is this useful to us". Triggers: "look into this tool", "is it useful for us", "put it on a canary", "what should we take from it", "find simpler alternatives".
